props.name: height
props.comment: Editor height in pixels when `autoHeight` is false. Defaults to 200.

props.name: autoHeight
props.comment: Grow with the content up to `maxHeight`. Defaults to true.

props.name: maxHeight
props.comment: Tallest the editor grows to when `autoHeight` is on. Defaults to 400.

props.name: empty
props.comment: Shown instead of the editor when the value is missing; translated if it is a message key.

props.name: monacoOptions
props.comment: Merged over the read-only defaults, so it can override any of them.

props.name: source
props.comment: Name of the property to display (dot/bracket path).

props.name: record
props.comment: The record to render. Defaults to the ambient `RecordContext` value.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Replaces ONLY a resolved `undefined`, never a present `null` / `0` / `""`.
